summary: A transaction groups several changes so they all happen or none of them do. BEGIN starts it, COMMIT saves it, and ROLLBACK cancels it.
notes: After ROLLBACK, the 3 Jazz Band enrollments are back as if the DELETE never ran.
Use a transaction when changes depend on each other, like dropping one class and adding another. If the second step fails, ROLLBACK keeps the student from ending up with neither class.
Without BEGIN, SQLite commits each statement on its own as soon as it runs.
pitfall: Running BEGIN while a transaction is already open gives Runtime error: cannot start a transaction within a transaction. Finish the first one with COMMIT or ROLLBACK.
